expectationBasis: Opening that commit entry as a visitor displays the changed-file path as an exact text value, the “Changed files” summary
The diff page displays the base and compare identifiers, the list of changed files, and added/deleted lines for each file
the “diff” page compares the file contents of two commits or revisions line by line
Refreshing or returning to commit history does not cause the read-only comparison to modify repository branches, commits, or files
the page reads and displays the changed files and line-by-line additions and deletions between them without creating a review, comment, or commit
visitors need not sign in to browse files, history, diffs, code search, or existing branches
if the user lacks permission to view either revision, its diff content is not displayed
private personal repositories allow access only to their owner and explicitly authorized subjects
its content is not shown to the visitor
